correctness.rationale: Each A_i strictly positive with two distinct positive eigenvalues because det A_i=s(cu1x_i+bu2y_i)+s²bc>0, and λ_i>sc. The rank-one secular equation 1=u1x_i/(λ_i−sb)+u2y_i/(λ_i−sc) uniquely defines λ_i. Equality λ0=λ1=L implies L−sc=R(L−sb), R=u2Δy/(u1Δx)∈(0,1), giving exactly the displayed s*>0; small-s λ0>λ1 whereas large-s λ1>λ0. Right Perron ray determinant has sign(λ0−λ1), while the left ray ratio z_i satisfying the derived positive-root quadratic is increasing in x and decreasing in y, so det[ℓ0,ℓ1]>0. The 2×2 spectral projector identity tr(P0P1)−1=−det[r0,r1]det[ℓ0,ℓ1]/[(ℓ0·r0)(ℓ1·r1)] converts the characteristic polynomial evaluation at λ0λ1 to sign(λ0λ1−ρ(A0A1))=sign(λ0−λ1). Hence unique strict change. At s*, both matrices share w and Λ*; positive componentwise comparison αw≤z0≤βw propagates through arbitrary switching products, proving common asymptotic rate. The long-block limit follows from rank-one Perron projectors. Independent exact example s*=28/45, Λ*=49/15, w=(9,10) and signs at s=1/4,1 were checked, not used as infinite proof.
residual_risks: Independent computations are bounded and do not replace the analytical all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: A uniquely determined switching advantage reversal in a natural two-stage population matrix family is biologically and mathematically interpretable. The common Perron ray at crossover gives a stronger exact arbitrary-order growth invariance than equal rates for two named periodic schedules; it is a structural boundary, not a synthetic numerical example.
residual_risks: Applicability is limited to the theorem hypotheses, not a generalization to all related objects or interventions.

final_claim: For A_i(s)=u v_i^T+s diag(b,c), u>0, 0<b<c, x0>x1>0, y1>y0>0, and u1(x0−x1)>u2(y1−y0), the alternating growth rate (1/2)logρ(A1A0) and long-block rate (1/2)log(ρ(A0)ρ(A1)) cross once at s*=[u1Δx−u2Δy](x0/Δx+y0/Δy)/(c−b). Blocks win for 0<s<s*, alternation for s>s*. At s* a common positive Perron vector and eigenvalue make arbitrary switching sequences asymptotically growth-indifferent.
limitations: Full 2006 autocorrelation article and full 2014 rank-one paper were not inspected; earlier equivalent special parameter family cannot be categorically excluded.
No statement for arbitrary Markov autocorrelation strength away from the exact crossing or higher-stage systems.
